import ffi as c (C!)

C! fn {
    int getpid(void);
}

C! struct Pair {
    c.int a;
    c.u8 data[4];
}

use Spec = {name: String, check: {pred: _, src: String} | nil, pos: Bool}

fn lisp(s) {
    s.scan(/(?:^[[:lower:]]+)|(?:[[:upper:]][[:lower:]]*)/)
     .join('-')
     .lower()
}

fn similar(name, longs: Array[String | nil]) {
    let close? = o -> o.edit-distance(name) <= 1 + max(1, #o / 4)
    [o for longs if (o != nil) && close?(o) where o = it]
}

fn describe(pred: Array[Int] | Range | Regex | (Int -> Bool)) -> String {
    let ok = match pred {
        set: Array | Range => 1 in set,
        pat: Regex         => 'x'.match?(pat),
        _                  => !!pred(1)
    }
    if !ok {
        return match pred {
            rng: Range => "range {rng}",
            pat: Regex => "regex {pat}",
            set: Array => "one of {set.join(', ')}",
            _          => 'check'
        }
    }
    'ok'
}

fn meta(spec: Spec) -> String | nil {
    if spec.check != nil && spec.check.pred :: Array {
        return spec.check.src.upper()
    }
    if spec.check != nil {
        return "{spec.check.src}!"
    }
    ''
}

fn widths(specs: Array[Spec]) -> Int {
    let entries = []
    for spec in specs {
        let label: _ = spec.name
        entries.push((label, spec.name ?? '', 'x'))
    }
    entries.map(\#_[0]).max() ?? 0
}

fn any-pos(specs: Array[Spec]) -> Bool {
    specs.any?(\!_.pos) || specs.all?(s -> s.pos)
}

fn camel(name: String) -> String {
    let [first, *rest] = name.split('-')
    rest.map!(s -> s[0].upper() + s[1;].lower())
    [first, *rest].join()
}

fn leading(lines: Array[String]) -> Int {
    lines.filter(\_).pop-while(\_ == '').map(l -> l.search(/\S/) ?? #l).min() ?? 0
}

let specs = [{name: 'alpha', check: {pred: [1, 2], src: '[1, 2]'}, pos: true}, {name: 'beta', check: nil, pos: false}]
print(lisp('HelloWorld'), similar('alpha', ['alpah', 'zzz', nil]), describe([2]), describe(1..3), describe(x -> x > 0))
print(meta(specs[0]), meta(specs[1]), widths(specs), any-pos(specs), camel('foo-bar-baz'), leading(['  a', '   b', '']))
print(getpid() > 0, Pair(a: 3).a)
